title: Cozy Mountain Cabin with Hot Tub
description:
Charming log cabin nestled in the mountains with a hot tub on the deck. Enjoy beautiful forest views and easy access to hiking trails. Perfect for a romantic retreat or small family vacation.

This authentic cabin features an open floor plan with vaulted ceilings and large windows that showcase the surrounding pine forest. The main living area includes a stone fireplace, comfortable seating, and a fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances.

The master bedroom has a king-size bed with premium linens, while the second bedroom features two twin beds. Both bathrooms are recently renovated with heated floors and rainfall showers.

Outdoor amenities include a spacious deck with a hot tub, BBQ grill, and seating area perfect for watching the sunset over the mountains. In winter, you're just a 10-minute drive from the ski slopes, and in summer, numerous hiking trails start right from the property.

host.name: Emma
host.bio: Hi! I'm Emma, an outdoor enthusiast and photographer who loves sharing my favorite mountain retreats with travelers. I've lived in Colorado for over 10 years and know all the best local spots.

reviews.comment: Absolutely stunning cabin! The hot tub was perfect after a day of hiking, and we loved the fireplace for cozy evenings. Emma was very responsive and provided great local recommendations.
Beautiful location and very comfortable cabin. We enjoyed our stay immensely. Only minor issue was that the wifi was a bit spotty, but that's to be expected in the mountains.
Perfect weekend getaway! The cabin was exactly as pictured, very clean, and had everything we needed. The hot tub under the stars was magical.
